summary: Find people who match the profile but are not actively applying and compile a list for outreach.

useCases.title: Source passive candidates on LinkedIn
useCases.message: Help me find passive candidates on LinkedIn. If you don't already know, ask me which role I am hiring for and what the ideal profile looks like. Then search for people who match but are not actively applying. Give me a list with profiles, titles, and a brief note on why each one fits.
